summary: Frontend-only E2E test of Sales Report 'Sembunyikan Kolom Pembayaran' feature. All 7 requested scenarios PASS via Playwright against live preview URL. Verified: (1) 8 chip toggles + 2 action buttons (Tampilkan/Sembunyikan Semua) + label 'Kolom Pembayaran:' render in toolbar above table with correct data-testids. (2) Toggle cash_plaza hides pay-total-cash_plaza cell + 'Cash Plaza' <th> header (colSpan=2) from DOM, button title flips to 'Klik untuk tampilkan' (icon Eye→EyeOff), localStorage 'salesReport.hiddenPayCols' becomes '["cash_plaza"]'. (3) Re-toggle restores column, LS='[]', title 'Klik untuk sembunyikan'. (4) pay-cols-hide-all removes all 8 pay-total-* cells from DOM, table style.minWidth shrinks 2360px→1200px, LS contains all 8 keys. (5) pay-cols-show-all restores all 8, LS='[]', button becomes disabled. (6) After hiding shopee_plaza + shopee_kastem then page.reload(), both stay hidden; LS still contains those 2 keys; other 6 remain visible — persistence works. (7) Regression: page-size-select switches to 50, report-row-search filters correctly ('ZZZ_NONEXISTENT'→0 rows, empty→1 row), export button state OK, footer dynamically renders pay-total-* only for visible cols (2 hidden → 6 present).

issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' fire briefly during initial render before ResponsiveContainer measures — cosmetic dev-mode warning, not related to this feature.

critical_code_review_comments: Implementation in /app/frontend/src/pages/SalesReport.jsx is clean: single visiblePayCols = PAY_COLS.filter(...) drives header (line 398-400), sub-header (403-408), body cells (452-464), and footer (484-491) — no drift.
totalColSpan (line 156) is recomputed from visiblePayCols.length — correctly used in loading/empty state colspan.
type='button' correctly applied to all toggle buttons (avoids form-submit inside potential enclosing forms).
localStorage persistence uses try/catch around getItem/setItem — safe against Safari private-mode failures.
Table style.minWidth math uses Math.max(1200, ...) so it never goes below 1200 even with all hidden (verified 2360→1200).

MINOR SUGGESTION (not blocking): the disabled attribute for pay-cols-hide-all when all 8 already hidden is present in code (line 374) but was not exercised — main agent may want to verify manually or add test. Also 'Sembunyikan Semua' button color contrast (zinc-600 on zinc-50) is subtle but acceptable per Excel-style aesthetic.
No a11y label on the color-only chip states — hidden state uses outline+EyeOff icon which is fine, but a screen-reader-only text (aria-pressed) would improve accessibility.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded data (1 sale visible in period). No mutations performed. localStorage cleaned up at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Toggle-Hide-Column feature on /laporan-penjualan is fully working. Key testids: toggle-pay-{cash_plaza,cash_kastem,bca_plaza,bca_kastem,mandiri_plaza,mandiri_kastem,shopee_plaza,shopee_kastem}, pay-cols-show-all, pay-cols-hide-all, pay-total-{key} (footer cells, dynamically rendered). Persistence via localStorage key 'salesReport.hiddenPayCols' (JSON array). Table style.minWidth recomputes from Math.max(1200, 12*90 + visiblePayCols.length*2*80). Icon toggles between Eye (visible) and EyeOff (hidden); chip color background applied only when visible. All regression endpoints (search, page-size, export) unaffected.
